observed_problem: The batch-timestamp wrapper charged the 3000-call transport budget once for every logical block inside a 40-block JSON-RPC batch and used those 40-block batches for each midpoint of the timestamp-to-block binary search. Twelve frozen window boundaries alone could exhaust the budget even though the provider saw only a small number of HTTP requests.
change: Count the bounded call budget per actual HTTP JSON-RPC request, including retries, rather than per block inside a batch.
Use exact cached single-block lookups for binary-search boundaries.
Use paced 40-block batches only for exact timestamps of observed Swap-log blocks.
If a provider rejects or partially fails a batch, discard the partial batch result and fail closed to exact paced single-block requests for that chunk.
Extend the deterministic self-test to prove boundary search does not invoke block batches.
unchanged: Ethereum chain and canonical Uniswap factory token and pool identities
Swap ABI and signed amount0 amount1 decoding
all model feature label cost target stop risk and leverage definitions
